Prelude Gift Set Hamper by Wangari – Premium Employee Welcome Kit

Ideal as an employee welcome kit, festive corporate gift, or executive onboarding hamper, this elegant gift set blends functionality, sustainability, and modern design. With a refined Packaging Type: Box and a versatile Product Type: Gift Set, it reflects professionalism while enhancing brand value.

This exclusive gift features high-utility essentials that today’s professionals truly appreciate. Each item is carefully selected to promote productivity, eco-conscious living, and everyday convenience, making it perfect for HR teams, corporates, startups, and enterprises looking to strengthen employee engagement.

What’s Inside

  • Wangari Custom Tabletop Calendar – Branded desk essential for daily planning and visibility
  • Wangari Eco-Friendly Diary with black denim & cork texture and flap closure – Sustainable, stylish, and durable
  • 500 ml Stainless Steel Sipper Flask (Black) – Sleek, reusable, and ideal for office or commute

Why Choose

The is crafted for organizations that value quality and sustainability. Each component aligns with modern corporate values while offering daily usability. Whether you are welcoming new employees, rewarding teams, or creating festive, this delivers both practicality and elegance.

The Wangari Aspen 10000 mAh Power Bank ensures uninterrupted productivity, while the Wangari Custom Tabletop Calendar keeps desks organized and branded all year round. The diary made with denim and cork texture highlights your company’s commitment to sustainability, an increasingly important factor in corporate gifting decisions.

Perfect Employee Welcome Kit Solution

SEO-Friendly Corporate Gifting Choice
